narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The hidden card must be the mean, ten point three seven five.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Cards in this game are whole numbers, and the other seven cards are whole too.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A mean can be a decimal even when no card is.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>The hidden card is not the mean.

<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then divide by eight, and you should get the mean you were given.
